# AfriShop

> AfriShop lets customers in the Democratic Republic of Congo shop products from top USA retailers (Amazon, eBay, Walmart, SHEIN, Tesla and more) with all-inclusive pricing, mobile-money payments, and door-to-door delivery from the USA to the DRC.

AfriShop handles sourcing, US-side purchase, customs, shipping, and last-mile delivery. Final prices include product cost, US sales tax, international shipping, customs, and local delivery — no surprise fees at checkout. Payments are accepted via mobile money (M-Pesa, Orange Money, Airtel Money) and international cards.
